Bash(docker-compose exec backend python -c "
from app.core.database import SessionLocal
from app.models.expense_item import ExpenseItem
from app.models.expense_category import ExpenseCategory

db = SessionLocal()

# Find the Incidentals category
incidentals_cat = db.query(ExpenseCategory).filter(ExpenseCategory.name == ''Incidentals'').first()

# Update all existing overnight expenses to have the new description
overnight_expenses = db.query(ExpenseItem).filter(
    ExpenseItem.category_id == incidentals_cat.id,
    ExpenseItem.description.like(''Overnight incidentals for%'')
).all()

print(f''Updating {len(overnight_expenses)} overnight expenses...'')

for expense in overnight_expenses:
    print(f''  Updating expense {expense.id}: {expense.description} -> Incidental Overnight Expenses'')
    expense.description = ''Incidental Overnight Expenses''

db.commit()
print(''Update complete!'')

db.close()
")
